angle: Most tools advertised as free are demos with a credit card behind them
hook: Most free AI tools are not free
caption:
Half the reels selling you free AI tools are describing trial credits. The tell is always the same and it takes ten seconds to check. This is the list of what is genuinely free versus what is a demo with a countdown attached.

🔖 Save this — you'll want it when it's relevant.

slides.text: Most *free* AI tools are not free
slides.subline: Here is how to tell in ten seconds

slides.text: There is a difference between a free tier and a free trial. Almost every reel selling you tools blurs it.

slides.title: The ten-second test
slides.body: Try to reach the pricing page without signing up. If the free column has a number of credits rather than a rate limit, it is a trial and it ends.

slides.left_text: Rate-limited forever. Resets daily or monthly. No card.
slides.right_text: A credit balance that runs out once and never refills.

slides.caption: a genuine free tier never asks for one up front

slides.title: Why they do it
slides.body: Trial credits convert better than free tiers, and reels about free tools get reach. Both incentives point the same way, so the language stays deliberately fuzzy.

slides.text: You won't see this anywhere else
